text: つきの　いしね…　そこらへんの　いしころと　どこが　ちがうんだろう？

structure.jp: そこらへんの　いしころと
structure.en: from the ordinary rocks lying around

structure.jp: どこが　ちがうんだろう？
structure.en: what part is different, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜とちがう
patterns.span: いしころと　どこが　ちがう
patterns.explanation: With ちがう, と shows the thing you are comparing against, so it means 'from', not 'and'. いしころと どこが ちがう = 'what part is different from ordinary rocks'.

patterns.name: 〜のだろう
patterns.explanation: んだろう after a question word shows the speaker is wondering and looking for an explanation; ん is the short spoken form of の. どこが ちがうんだろう = 'I wonder how it is different'.
